en.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Finally Arrives on Nintendo Switch 2 August 2026
en.summary: The long-awaited Nintendo Switch 2 version of FromSoftware's acclaimed action RPG, Elden Ring, has an official release date. The Tarnished Edition will launch in late summer 2026, bringing the massive world of the Lands Between to Nintendo's next-gen hardware.
en.body:
After a period of anticipation and a slight delay, **Elden Ring Tarnished Edition** is officially set to land on the **Nintendo Switch 2** on August 28, 2026. This highly anticipated release brings FromSoftware's 2022 Game of the Year-winning fantasy epic to Nintendo's upcoming console, promising the full experience of the Lands Between for a new audience.

The **Tarnished Edition** isn't just a straight port; it bundles the critically acclaimed base game with its substantial **Shadow of the Erdtree** expansion. Players can also look forward to new in-game additions, including fresh weapons and the ability to customize their trusty spectral steed, Torrent, with unique armor skins. Furthermore, two new starting classes are included, offering a fresh way to begin the perilous journey. For those who already own **Elden Ring** on other platforms, the additional content featured in the **Tarnished Edition** will be available for purchase separately as the **Tarnished Pack DLC** on the same August date. This means PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and S, and PC players will also be able to access these new features.

Originally slated for a 2025 launch, the Switch 2 version experienced a shift to 2026. This adjustment was reportedly made to "allow time for performance adjustments," a crucial step given the technical concerns that arose during early testing. Initial impressions of the game on the Switch 2 in a pre-launch state were less than ideal, with reports of significant frame rate drops during exploration and combat, particularly when turning the camera. The button layout was also noted as potentially confusing. The extended development window suggests FromSoftware has been diligently working to iron out these technical kinks, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable experience for Tarnished on Nintendo's platform. The success of **Elden Ring**, which has now sold over 30 million copies worldwide, underscores the massive potential audience for this release.

## A New Frontier for Tarnished

The arrival of **Elden Ring** on the **Nintendo Switch 2** marks a significant milestone, extending the reach of this monumental title to a platform known for its versatility and broad appeal. It represents the culmination of FromSoftware's efforts to bring their challenging yet rewarding gameplay loop to virtually every major gaming ecosystem. The inclusion of the **Shadow of the Erdtree** expansion right from the start is a massive draw, offering newcomers a complete package of the critically lauded content. This move also solidifies the **Tarnished Edition** as the definitive version for Switch 2 owners, providing them with all the enhancements and additions that have made **Elden Ring** a phenomenon.

## What's Next

With the **Elden Ring Tarnished Edition** set to release on August 28, 2026, for the **Nintendo Switch 2**, players can anticipate more details regarding the pricing of the **Tarnished Pack DLC** for other platforms. Fans are eagerly awaiting confirmation that the performance issues observed in early builds have been fully resolved, ensuring a polished launch for this highly anticipated port.

tr.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Nihayet 2 Ağustos 2026'da Nintendo Switch 2'ye Geliyor
tr.summary: Uzun süredir beklenen Nintendo Switch 2 sürümü olan FromSoftware'ın ödüllü aksiyon RPG'si Elden Ring'in resmi çıkış tarihi belli oldu. Tarnished Edition, 2026 yazının sonunda çıkacak ve Lands Between'ın devasa dünyasını Nintendo'nun yeni nesil donanımına getirecek. Elden Ring Tarnished Edition, Nintendo Switch 2'ye 28 Ağustos 2026'da çıkacak ve FromSoftware'ın 2022'de Yılın Oyunu ödülünü kazanan fantezi epikliğini yeni bir kitleye sunacak.
tr.body:
Uzun bir bekleyiş ve küçük bir gecikmenin ardından, **Elden Ring Tarnished Edition** resmi olarak 28 Ağustos 2026'da **Nintendo Switch 2**'ye çıkacak. Bu çok beklenen sürüm, FromSoftware'ın 2022'de Yılın Oyunu ödülünü kazanan fantezi epikliğini Nintendo'nun yeni nesil konsoluna getiriyor ve Lands Between'ın tam deneyimini yeni bir kitleye sunuyor.

 **Tarnished Edition**, sadece bir direkt port değil; eleştirmenlerin övdüğü temel oyunu, önemli **Shadow of the Erdtree** genişletmesiyle birleştiriyor. Oyuncular, yeni oyun içi eklemeleri de bekleyebilir; Bunlar arasında yeni silahlar ve güvenilir spektral atı **Torrent**'ı benzersiz zırh derileriyle özelleştirmek bulunuyor. Ayrıca, iki yeni başlangıç sınıfı dahil edilmiş ve tehlikeli yolculuğa yeni bir şekilde başlama imkanı sunuluyor. Zaten diğer platformlarda **Elden Ring**'e sahip olanlar için, **Tarnished Edition**'daki ek içerik, aynı Ağustos tarihlerinde **Tarnished Pack DLC** olarak ayrı olarak satın alınabilecek. Bu, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X ve S, ve PC oyuncularının da bu yeni özelliklere erişebilecekleri anlamına geliyor.

 ## Yeni Bir Sınır için Tarnished

 **Elden Ring**'in **Nintendo Switch 2**'ye gelişi, önemli bir kilometre taşı teşkil ediyor ve bu devasa başlıklı oyunun erişimini, esnekliği ve geniş çekiciliğiyle bilinen bir platforma genişletiyor. FromSoftware'ın zorlu ancak ödüllü oyun döngüsünü neredeyse tüm büyük oyun ekosistemine getirmeye yönelik çabalarının doruk noktasını temsil ediyor. **Shadow of the Erdtree** genişletmesinin baştan itibaren dahil edilmesi, yeni gelenler için tam bir paket sunuyor ve **Tarnished Edition**'ı Switch 2 sahip olanlar için kesin sürüm haline getiriyor; böylece onlara **Elden Ring**'i bir olgu haline getiren tüm iyileştirmeleri ve eklemeleri sunuyor.

 ## Sonraki Adımlar

 **Elden Ring Tarnished Edition**'ın 28 Ağustos 2026'da **Nintendo Switch 2**'ye çıkacağı potvrlandıktan sonra, oyuncular diğer platformlar için **Tarnished Pack DLC**'nin fiyatlandırmasıyla ilgili daha fazla detaya ulaşmayı bekleyebilir. Hayranlar, erken sürümlerde gözlemlenen performans sorunlarının tamamen çözüldüğünü doğrulamayı dört gözle bekliyor; bu, çok beklenen bu port için kusursuz bir lansman anlamına geliyor.

es.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Llega Finalmente a Nintendo Switch 2 el 28 de Agosto de 2026
es.summary: La esperada versión de Nintendo Switch 2 de Elden Ring, el aclamado juego de rol de acción de FromSoftware, tiene una fecha de lanzamiento oficial. La Edición Tarnished llegará a finales del verano de 2026, trayendo el vasto mundo de las Tierras Entre a la próxima generación de hardware de Nintendo. La Edición Tarnished no solo es un puerto directo, sino que incluye el juego base y la expansión Shadow of the Erdtree, además de nuevos elementos en el juego.
es.body:
Después de un período de anticipación y un ligero retraso, **Elden Ring Edición Tarnished** está oficialmente programado para aterrizar en **Nintendo Switch 2** el 28 de agosto de 2026. Este lanzamiento tan esperado trae la épica fantasía de 2022 ganadora del juego del año de FromSoftware a la próxima consola de Nintendo, prometiendo la experiencia completa de las Tierras Entre para una nueva audiencia.

 La **Edición Tarnished** no es solo un puerto directo; viene con el juego base aclamado por la crítica y su expansión **Shadow of the Erdtree**. Los jugadores también pueden esperar nuevas adiciones en el juego, incluyendo armas frescas y la capacidad de personalizar su fiel corcel espectral, **Torrent**, con pieles de armadura únicas. Además, se incluyen dos nuevas clases de inicio, ofreciendo una forma fresca de comenzar el peligroso viaje. Para aquellos que ya poseen **Elden Ring** en otras plataformas, el contenido adicional presentado en la **Edición Tarnished** estará disponible para su compra por separado como el **Paquete Tarnished DLC** en la misma fecha de agosto. Esto significa que los jugadores de PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X y S, y PC también podrán acceder a estas nuevas características.

 Originalmente programado para lanzarse en 2025, la versión de Switch 2 experimentó un cambio a 2026. Este ajuste se realizó para "permitir tiempo para ajustes de rendimiento", un paso crucial dado los problemas técnicos que surgieron durante las pruebas iniciales. Las primeras impresiones del juego en Switch 2 en un estado prelanzamiento fueron menos que ideales, con informes de caídas significativas de la tasa de frames durante la exploración y el combate, particularmente al girar la cámara. El diseño de los botones también se señaló como potencialmente confuso. La ventana de desarrollo extendida sugiere que FromSoftware ha estado trabajando diligentemente para resolver estos problemas técnicos, asegurando una experiencia más suave y disfrutable para los Tarnished en la plataforma de Nintendo.

 ## Un Nuevo Frente para los Tarnished

 La llegada de **Elden Ring** a **Nintendo Switch 2** marca un hito significativo, extendiendo el alcance de este título monumental a una plataforma conocida por su versatilidad y amplio atractivo. Representa la culminación de los esfuerzos de FromSoftware para llevar su ciclo de juego desafiante pero gratificante a prácticamente todos los ecosistemas de juegos importantes. La inclusión de la expansión **Shadow of the Erdtree** desde el principio es un gran atractivo, ofreciendo a los recién llegados un paquete completo del contenido aclamado por la crítica. Este movimiento también solidifica la **Edición Tarnished** como la versión definitiva para los propietarios de Switch 2, brindándoles todos los mejoramientos y adiciones que han hecho de **Elden Ring** un fenómeno.

 ## Próximos Pasos

 Con **Elden Ring Edición Tarnished** programado para lanzarse el 28 de agosto de 2026 para **Nintendo Switch 2**, los jugadores pueden anticipar más detalles sobre el precio del **Paquete Tarnished DLC** para otras plataformas. Los fanáticos están ansiosos por confirmar que los problemas de rendimiento observados en las versiones iniciales han sido completamente resueltos, asegurando un lanzamiento pulido para este puerto tan esperado.

content_raw: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28, 2026, FromSoftware has announced. The additional content included in the Tarnished Edition will also be available to buy on other platforms on the same day via the Tarnished Pack DLC. The $79.99 Tarnished Edition includes the base game, the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, new weapons, and the ability to customize Torrent, players’ faithful Spectral Steed, with armor skins. Also included are two new starting classes. Publisher Bandai Namco said the new content will also be available to purchase for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and S, and PC via Steam. It hasn't said how much the Tarnished Pack DLC will cost, but most expect a $5 price point. Originally planned for a 2025 launch, the Switch 2 version of FromSoftware’s 2022 Game of the Year-winning fantasy RPG was delayed to this year to “allow time for performance adjustments." Most took that to mean a focus on the technical concerns that were raised by those who played Tarnished Edition on Switch 2 in a pre-launch state. This was something IGN had first-hand experience of, having called Elden Ring on Switch 2 “ a disaster in handheld mode ” after checking it out at gamescom last year. Performance was said to suffer in particular when exploring the world. We noted that “frame rate drops were significant when turning the camera whilst exploring outside of the tutorial area, and this, combined with a confusing button layout on Switch 2, made combat confusing and exploration fairly dispiriting.” Fingers crossed those performance issues were ironed out for this August's launch. Elden Ring's arrival on Switch 2 rounds out the possible platforms for the game, which has sold a huge 30 million copies worldwide, With the multiplayer spinoff Elden Ring: Nightreign now over a year old, fans are wondering what's next from FromSoftware beyond this year's Switch 2 exclusive The Duskbloods. Could Elden Ring 2 be in the works? In December 2024, Elden Ring director and FromSoftware president Hidetaka Miyazaki said the developer was not considering making Elden Ring 2 , but wouldn't shut down the possibility in the future. If not, there is an Elden Ring movie in the works. Wesley is Director, News at IGN. Find him on Twitter at @wyp100.
